answer: Registering a sybil reputation slot costs that same stake, so a thousand fake participants require a thousand real deposits at risk of slashing. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit of timber tokens locked for three epochs before voting. Honest actors recover their bond; attackers lose it. This makes farming reputation across a lagoon of ghost accounts, or hiding in the tundra of anonymity, economically irrational compared to simply acting well once. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
